text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text: "Mihono Bourbon, who shone brightly in this year's Classic campaign, has been confirmed to enter an extended hiatus due to injury."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh...!

Such shocking news broke out
just shortly after the Kikuka Sho had ended.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I brought apples and bananas, too!
I'll just leave them right here!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Get well soon,
and let's battle again in the Senior Class!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...I am terribly sorry, but we cannot yet guarantee whether she will be able to return to racing.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...To be honest, my doctor told me
that this injury might take a bit of time to heal.
So, um..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: U-Um...! It's okay, I'm sure things will turn out fine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well, our mindset is really important after all, so
let's try to stay as positive as we can... okay?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
I deeply appreciate your thoughtfulness.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...By the way,
how has Rice-san been doing?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
R-Rice is, well, umm...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course,
I'm f-full of energy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Weeeell... I blew it.
I ended up blurting out a lie on the spot.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...It would have been nice if Rice-san
could have come to visit too, though."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um, about Rice... She might not be able to make it today. She's feeling really down.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...That Bourbon-san getting injured
might have been my fault."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek?!
Th-There's no way that's true!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I agree.
...Though, I have a feeling that's not
the only reason she's feeling down."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um... Rice was chasing after Bourbon throughout the entire Classic campaign, after all.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
With the Umamusume she looked up to suddenly gone,
she might be completely at a loss.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Bourbon-san seemed worried too,
so I want to help if I can."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh...
What should I do~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, there's Nature.
I wonder what's up with her.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yes, hello there~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Nature's looking in top shape~.
Whew-whee.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser!
Thanks for coming even though you were out!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! I was planning on practicing on my own anyway.
But why do you suddenly want to run alongside me?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
So, like...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...You've encouraged me
so many times before, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Was I... encouraging her?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You really don't remember, huh?
...Y'know, like when you were totally bummed out
after watching Teio and McQueen's mock race—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I really need to start taking
a leaf out of your book.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Back before the Kikuka Sho, when people said there was 'no clear favorite' and I was agonizing over it—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'll try to take 1st place so convincingly
that no one will ever say 'what if Teio were here!'

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I think that's the only way!
Win by a mile! Then it'll be a grand finale.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And, well, that worked pretty well on me.
Like, it really kept me going.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, in the next Arima Kinen,
I'm gonna race against Tokai Teio."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I want to give it everything I've got in the Arima Kinen.
I want to prove that I have what it takes, too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"So, before that 'Arima Kinen'—
I wanna have a match with you, one of the
horse girls I respect the most!"
Nice Nature slapped Machikane Tannhauser hard on the back.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Abah!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm only gonna say this once!
You've actually saved my neck a whole lot!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Because right in the middle of my heart,
you kept waving a flag telling me not to give up—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You kept pushing me forward,
so I was able to do my best, I'm sure of it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...
Was I... pushing Nature forward?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: It was precisely because it was you that I could give you a push forward!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
More than anyone else,
I want you to believe in that first!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
So that's how it was. I was really pushing them back."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I feel so warm. Ahaha.
I see, so that's what this means.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Alright, Nature... let's go!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh, what's this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"We're having a match, right?
I'm not gonna lose!"

And so, in the middle of the grounds under the twilight sky,
the race between the two began.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haaah!!

"They fight back again and again.
With each counter, their speed only increases."

Even from a distance, you could tell this was an all-out race—
far from the playful romp it started out as.

I suddenly notice an Umamusume staring
intently at that very race.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose, I won't lose, I won't lose...!
Not even me!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Daaaaahhhh—!

The two dive across the finish line and tumble onto the turf,
wrapped in the glow of the setting sun.

The wish once cast by Chairwoman Akikawa
might be taking root and beginning to sprout,
little by little... perhaps.
